topSignals.title: UBS raises Bloom Energy price target to $325 (from $300), reiterates Buy, on the S&P 500-inclusion catalyst.
topSignals.text: Analyst Manav Gupta's revision — up from the $300 PT set July 30 — cites Bloom's confirmed addition to the S&P 500 (effective before the open on Sept 21) and the company's "behind-the-meter power" strength for AI data centers. First analyst price-target move logged since the Sept 4 index-inclusion announcement. TipRanks/TheFly

topSignals.title: Elcogen: confirmed quiet for a tenth straight day.
topSignals.text: Direct newsroom check (elcogen.com/category/news, re-verified today) shows nothing posted since the Aug 31 write-up of the Aug 24 Paris MoU with China Southern Power Grid group company Guangzhou Xinzhili Energy Technology. Status unchanged: elcoStack E3000 G2 platform (>75% FC electrical efficiency, 90% with heat recovery, 650°C) in volume production at ELCO I Tallinn (360 MW/yr). Elcogen News

topSignals.title: Topsoe: SOFC/SOEC side still quiet.
topSignals.text: Direct press-releases check (topsoe.com/press-releases) shows nothing beyond the already-logged Aug 27 H1 2026 results and the March 2026 SOEC pathway reset (Herning hibernation). The site's two featured items — the H1 statement and CEO Elena Scaltritti's appointment — are both old news, not new developments. No SOFC-specific announcement identified today. items.text: Elcogen (priority): See Top Signal #2. No other announcements found.
Topsoe (priority): See Top Signal #3. No SOFC/SOEC-specific announcement identified.

Ceres Power: No new stack/cell news. Last items remain the Sept 1 "Net Zero Champion" award and the Aug 26 RFC Power/Certain Energy spin-out (£10M Series A, ~37% retained stake); no update on the Centrica/Delta Electronics partnership. H1 2026 interim results still confirmed for Sept 23.
No new stack/cell announcements found from Bloom, FuelCell Energy, Sunfire, SolydEra, Mitsubishi Power, Kyocera, Aisin, or Convion.

Spain's draft data-center renewables decree (80% new-renewables, hourly-matched, ≥1 MW facilities): Public consultation window closed Sept 4 as scheduled; the Council of Ministers has not yet finalized or published final decree terms. Still positioned as the first EU country-level rule of this scope — worth a follow-up once final terms land. PV-Tech background
FERC RM26-4 large-load interconnection: Unchanged; RTO/ISO show-cause responses due Nov 16, 2026.
Virginia data-center electricity tax ($0.011/kWh, applies to self-generated power too): Unchanged; first monthly returns due this month.
Germany EnEfG amendment: Unchanged; still awaiting a Bundestag/Bundesrat floor vote this autumn — no schedule confirmed.
Rolls-Royce SMR UK GDA, Texas ERCOT audit, US ITC 45V/48E, EU CADA, PJM Reliability Backstop Procurement (residual-auction bid window Sept 30–Oct 21): unchanged carry-forward.

Bloom Energy (BE): Markets reopen today after the Labor Day holiday — first full trading session since Friday. Last confirmed close: Sept 4, $252.87 (+7.35%), after-hours $266.14 (+5.25%) on the S&P 500-inclusion announcement. UBS PT raise to $325 — see Top Signal #1. Today's intraday session was not yet indexed as of this digest. Next catalysts: 10-Q (Sept 11), securities-fraud lead-plaintiff deadline (Sept 28), Q3 2026 earnings (Oct 27).

FuelCell Energy (FCEL): Last confirmed close: Sept 4, $14.95 (+1.91%), day range $14.50–15.09. Analyst consensus "Buy" (8 analysts), 12-month PT $20.86 (+39.5% implied). Next catalyst: 100 MW annualized production-rate target (Oct 2026).
Ceres Power (CWR.L): No new pricing or disclosures. H1 2026 interim results confirmed for Sept 23.
